author: freeCodeCamp.org
description:
Learn how to build a complete Wikipedia search engine entirely within PostgreSQL using BM25 keyword matching, vector embeddings, and reciprocal rank fusion. This step-by-step course covers setting up `pg_textsearch` and `pgvector-scale`, analyzing query plans, tuning hybrid weights, and serving results through a FastAPI backend. By keeping your data, keyword indexes, and vectors inside a single database, you eliminate complex synchronization pipelines and unlock fast, transactional search.

Code: https://github.com/beaucarnes/wikisearch

Try Tiger Data Cloud: https://tsdb.co/fcc-postgres-search

Chapters
- 00:00 Introduction & Project Overview
- 04:06 Matching vs. Ranking & PostgreSQL Text Search
- 07:20 Understanding BM25 (IDF, Term Frequency, & Document Length)
- 11:39 Setting Up Tiger Data Cloud & PostgreSQL
- 14:06 Environment Setup & Enabling Database Extensions
- 15:43 Loading Wikipedia Dataset & Schema Setup
- 20:30 Native PostgreSQL Full-Text Search Baseline
- 24:38 Analyzing
title: PostgreSQL Hybrid Search Course – Keyword (BM25) + Vector Retrieval
